author: AuroraPerego
body:
#### PR description:

Calling the `sort()` method on a `mapWithSharedEnergy`/`mapWithFraction` leads to a compile-time error.
The reason is that the `sort()` method in the `TICLAssociationMap` is missing `constexpr` in the `if (byScore && IsValueTypeWithScore<V>::value)`, leading to the block of code within this `if` being always compiled. However, in those two cases, `score()` is not defined and the compilation fails.

This PR guards that block of code with `if (constexpr IsValueTypeWithScore<V>::value)`, leaving the `if (byScore)` check at runtime. It also adds a `requires is_one_to_one` to methods that work only with one-to-one maps, but nothing prevented them from being called with one-to-many. 
I also added the test that I used to check all methods in the `TICLAssociationMap`.

#### PR validation:

The new test added passes.
title: fix a bug in `TICLAssociationMap` and add a test
